name: starmemory
description: Enterprise memory plugin for Claude Code: LMDB + faiss HNSW (via tenann) + Tantivy BM25 hybrid local recall, with optional sync to a central StarRocks store.

scripts.build:native: cd native-text && PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo build --release && cp "target/release/libstarmemory_text.$(uname | grep -q Darwin && echo dylib || echo so)" starmemory_text.node
